TA0031.title: AI Fraud Gangs
TA0031.description: AI fraud gangs are organized criminal groups specializing in artificial intelligence technologies, particularly deepfakes, large language models, and voice cloning. They may develop or customize AI attack tools for video-call fraud, clone voices to impersonate friends or executives and bypass Voice Authentication, generate phishing content at scale with LLMs, and use Digital Humans for deceptive livestream commerce. These groups combine AI capabilities with bulk accounts, social-engineering data, automated distribution, and money-transfer channels to create scalable attack operations. Their technical automation increases attack volume and credibility beyond traditional fraud operations.

references.title: AI Fraud Case Analysis - Ministry of Public Security
